title: Evaluating Amphenol’s (APH) AI Infrastructure Play

content_html:
Soumya Eswaran

Fri, August 14, 2026 at 6:26 AM PDT 3 min read

Aoris Investment Management, a specialist international equity manager, released its Q2 2026 investor letter for "Aoris International Fund". A copy of the letter can be downloaded here. The fund invests in high-quality, wealth-generating businesses managed by prudent and capable teams, targeting an annual return of 8–12% after fees over a 5–7-year market cycle. During the June quarter, international equity markets, as represented by the MSCI AC World Accumulation Index ex Australia, returned 13.8% in AUD terms. In local currencies, the return 15.1%. The Portfolio's Class A (Unhedged) returned 5.7% after fees, underperforming its benchmark by 8.1%, while the Class C (Hedged) gained 6.7%, 8.4% less than its benchmark. The June quarter continued to reflect an unusual year, marked by significant share price increases among AI infrastructure companies, particularly semiconductor producers and data center suppliers. Economic sectors like banks and commodity producers saw gains, but the firm chose not to invest due to their cyclicality and low growth prospects. Conversely, concerns about enterprise software and data companies, challenged by AI, negatively impacted performance. The letter outlined potential incremental opportunities for portfolio companies through AI. Additionally, reviewing the Fund's top five holdings could help identify its best picks for 2026.

In its Q2 2026 investor letter, Aoris International Fund highlighted Amphenol Corporation (NYSE:APH). Amphenol Corporation (NYSE:APH) is a leading manufacturer of electrical, electronic, and fiber optic connectors serving a broad range of end markets. On August 13, 2026, Amphenol Corporation (NYSE:APH) closed at $165.75 per share. One-month return of Amphenol Corporation (NYSE:APH) was 9.62%, and its shares gained 51.77% over the past 52 weeks. Amphenol Corporation (NYSE:APH) has a market capitalization of $204.37 billion.

Aoris International Fund stated the following regarding Amphenol Corporation (NYSE:APH) in its Q2 2026 investor letter:

"Amphenol Corporation (NYSE:APH): Amphenol is the leading global producer of interconnect devices, which transfer data and power in electrical systems, and sensors that convert physical signals to electrical data. It sells into a wide range of end markets including commercial aerospace, automotive, mobile devices, mobile networks, data centres, and defence.

How AI may benefit the business: Amphenol has been a clear beneficiary of the buildout in data centre infrastructure, which has grown to one-third of its revenue. AI data centres require more high-performance connectors and cables than conventional cloud infrastructure, and Amphenol has captured a meaningful share of this spending. In the March 2026 quarter, its data centre revenue grew 81% versus the prior year.

What investors are concerned about: The natural question is whether Amphenol's current data centre revenue is sustainable. The major AI infrastructure companies continue to indicate that demand exceeds supply, but expectations are high and the market will be sensitive to any signs of slowing…" (Click here to read the full text)

太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 8 月 14 日星期五上午 6:26 阅读时间 3 分钟

专业国际股票管理公司 Aoris Investment Management 发布了“Aoris International Fund”2026 年第二季度投资者信函。 该信函的副本可以在此处下载。 该基金投资于由审慎、精干的团队管理的优质、创富企业，目标是在5-7年的市场周期内实现扣除费用后8-12%的年回报率。 在第二季度，以除澳大利亚以外的 MSCI AC 世界累积指数为代表的国际股票市场以澳元计算回报率为 13.8%。 以当地货币计算，回报率为15.1%。 该投资组合的 A 类（未对冲）扣除费用后的回报率为 5.7%，比基准低 8.1%，而 C 类（对冲）则上涨 6.7%，比基准低 8.4%。 六月季度继续反映出不寻常的一年，人工智能基础设施公司，特别是半导体生产商和数据中心供应商的股价大幅上涨。 银行和大宗商品生产商等经济部门取得了增长，但由于其周期性和低增长前景，该公司选择不进行投资。 相反，对受到人工智能挑战的企业软件和数据公司的担忧会对业绩产生负面影响。 这封信概述了投资组合公司通过人工智能潜在的增量机会。 此外，审查该基金的前五名持仓可能有助于确定 2026 年的最佳选择。

Aoris International Fund 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信函中重点关注了安费诺公司（NYSE：APH）。 安费诺公司（纽约证券交易所代码：APH）是电气、电子和光纤连接器的领先制造商，服务于广泛的终端市场。 2026 年 8 月 13 日，安费诺公司（纽约证券交易所代码：APH）收于每股 165.75 美元。 安费诺公司（NYSE：APH）的一个月回报率为 9.62%，其股价在过去 52 周内上涨了 51.77%。 安费诺公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：APH）的市值为 2043.7 亿美元。

Aoris International Fund 在其 2026 年第 2 季度投资者信函中就 Amphen Corporation（纽约证券交易所股票代码：APH）发表了以下声明：

“安费诺公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：APH）：安费诺是全球领先的互连设备生产商，其产品在电气系统中传输数据和电力，以及将物理信号转换为电气数据的传感器。 它销往广泛的终端市场，包括商业航空、汽车、移动设备、移动网络、数据中心和国防。 人工智能如何使业务受益：安费诺一直是数据中心基础设施建设的明显受益者，该基础设施已增长至其收入的三分之一。 与传统云基础设施相比，人工智能数据中心需要更多的高性能连接器和电缆，而安费诺在这一支出中占据了相当大的份额。 2026 年 3 月季度，其数据中心收入较上年增长 81%。 投资者关心的问题：自然的问题是安费诺目前的数据中心收入是否可持续。 主要人工智能基础设施公司继续表示需求超过供应，但预期很高，市场将对任何放缓迹象都很敏感……” （点击此处阅读全文）
